facts.F252: Usage data (DEVOPS obligation): name-only event FeatureListSearched = 31, no property: never the text, the list, the team or portfolio, or a match count. FeatureListDataGrid owns the once-per-visit latch because DataGridBase is shared and must stay unaware of usage data: it holds the search text through the search prop callback, and the first time that text is non-empty it calls useUsageDataReporter() and spends the latch (a useRef flag) only when the reporter answers that the use was recorded, so an answer that has not yet arrived does not burn it. The latch is per mount, so each page visit and each list reports at most once; clearing and retyping does not report again. The producer is the DataGridBase search prop gaining an onTextChange callback (text string), the only new data crossing the boundary.

facts.F62: Paradigm: the repository frontend is hooks and pure functions inside an object-oriented project; this feature adds no class. Carriers: search text is a useState in DataGridBase (per mount, never persisted, empty on every open); the narrowing itself is MUI filterModel.quickFilterValues, set with apiRef.setQuickFilterValues(quickSearchValues(text)); the pure core is the new DataGridBase-adjacent module quickSearch.ts (quickSearchValues and the per-column quick filter). Effects stay in DataGridBase and the toolbar; the core calls neither.
facts.F63: Matching rule (D2, as the cell reads): use the MUI quick filter, not a custom row pre-filter. The whole trimmed text is ONE literal value, case-insensitive substring, matched against each shown column text. Shown text = the column valueFormatter result when the column has one, else its raw value when that is a string or number. Objects, arrays, undefined and booleans are never matched, so typing obj never matches every row via [object Object] and true never matches Active Work. MUI already excludes hidden columns and gives no quick filter to boolean and actions columns. Columns with no text value (Progress, Forecasted Start, Forecasted Completion, Likelihood, Warnings, Active Work) are not searchable; this is the declared residue. Why the quick filter: it already narrows together with column filters (P7) and opens the first page on a changed value (P8, MUI useGridPaginationModel), which a custom pre-filter would have to rebuild as OpensFirstPageOnSearch does. Rejected: matching every column raw value (wrong for count, boolean and object columns), per-column getApplyQuickFilterFn overrides on each page column (many sites, easy to forget), one custom filter over rendered text (renderCell is a React node, no text).
facts.F64: Name text: the shown Name cell text is getWorkItemName(name, referenceId) (utils/featureName.ts is the only owner; unparented names and GUID ids show the name alone). createNameColumn exposes it as valueFormatter first (so search finds the ID) and then, in the Name filter slice, as valueGetter plus a sortComparator over row.name using gridStringOrNumberComparator, so column sort and any getCellValue consumer keep seeing the name as today while the column filter sees the shown text. The Delivery Work Items tab name column is a second copy of the same cell and adopts the shared factory.
facts.F65: UI placement (agreed sketch): DataGridToolbar gets an optional search prop and renders the new GridSearchBox at the left of the toolbar row (search icon, placeholder, clear button); the other toolbar icons stay right-aligned. DataGridBase takes an optional search prop (placeholder, later the no-match copy) and renders no box without it. FeatureListDataGrid is the only caller that passes it, so Refinement, Archived, FeatureGrid, WorkItemsDialog, ReportList, ConnectionsSettings, ThirdPartyPackages and DataOverviewTable gain nothing. Copy uses the configured term: placeholder Search ${features term}; no match: No ${features term} match "${text}". (Confirms the Proposed placeholder/no-match decision; DELIVER sketch already agreed.) Reuse verdict: FilterBar (full-width own row, Ctrl+F, portfolio/team wording) and the ThirdPartyPackages TextField (pre-filters rows, own page-reset hook) are not the target; MUI TextField is reused inside a new small GridSearchBox.
facts.F66: Loading and failure (Open decision F47, resolved): the box lives inside the grid, so it is shown whenever the grid is mounted and stays usable while data loads (it narrows what is loaded; the existing loading overlay or dimming shows). Wherever the page already replaces the grid (lone spinner with nothing to dim, the could-not-load look, the Delivery tab Loading and no-Features texts) there is no box and those looks stay exactly as they are. No new loading or failure look is added. The no-Features message is untouched and distinct from the no-match message because the grid shows noRowsLabel for an empty list and noResultsOverlayLabel for a narrowed-to-nothing list.
facts.F67: Checker map: No model for the search narrowing: it is a stateless pure row filter over an already loaded list; there is no shared state, multi-step protocol, retry, crash or concurrency window (the only asynchrony is MUI zero-delay debounced page reset, which cannot change which rows match). Quint 0.33.1 is installed but no claim needs it. The laws are checked by native property tests (fast-check 4.10.3, declared in package.json) on the pure core plus component examples; nothing is claimed formally verified. Liveness: no liveness claim, the filter is synchronous and always enabled. MUI behaviours relied on were read in the installed @mui/x-data-grid 9.18.0 source (quick filter reads getRowFormattedValue; excludes hidden columns; boolean and actions columns have a null quick filter; filterModel change navigates to page 0; localeText noResultsOverlayLabel; apiRef.setQuickFilterValues) and are pinned by the component oracles.
facts.F68: Cross-layer algebra. Domain (pure core, quickSearch.ts): states = query text; operations = quickSearchValues(text) -> [] or [trimmed text], shownTextQuickFilter(value) -> null or predicate over one cell; observation = which rows remain. Application (FeatureListDataGrid/DataGridBase): passes the search prop, owns the text state, calls setQuickFilterValues; outcomes = rows narrowed, no-match message, page 0. Adapter (MUI DataGrid): applies the quick filter together with column filters. Infrastructure and recovery: none, nothing is stored or fetched; a reload or remount returns an empty box, which is the specified behaviour.
